title: Replacing Master/Slave terminology with Central/Peripheral
description: Follow up to https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/0a651f7cc1fc8c4ff5212c79ec7d8f286433f2eb to just find and replace update the terminology from Master/Slave to Central/Peripheral as is used in the latest Bluetooth specifications ([5.4 ammended](https://www.bluetooth.com/specifications/specs/core-specification-amended-5-4/) at the time of writing.) Previous changes primarily affected BT BR/EDR & HCI, not BT LE, which is addressed here.
